destination.description: The destination name to copy the file or directory to. If the destination is a directory, the source will be copied into this directory. No file paths allowed.

function.name: find
function.description: This tool belongs to the Gorilla file system. It is a simple file system that allows users to perform basic file operations such as navigating directories, creating files and directories, reading and writing to files, etc. Tool description: Find any file or directories under specific path that contain name in its file name.
